title: Ruth Stays with Naomi
traveler_why: Willow is the Traveler whose gift is staying close and comforting, and tonight Ruth stays beside a grieving Naomi when everyone expects her to go home: Willow skips the cousins’ game to sit with a sad Grandma and hold her hand.
traveler_about: Willow fits tonight because she stays close when someone is sad. In Willow’s world today: Grandma comes to visit, and she is quiet because she misses Grandpa. The cousins run outside to play and call for Willow to come. Willow climbs up next to Grandma instead and holds her hand, and they look at the old photo album together. Just like Ruth, who would not leave Naomi, Willow learned that love stays close.
